Common.Loading: Reading compendiums… (only slow the first time)

Plan.SheetHint: Plans the levels ahead from the sheet as it is now.
Plan.FreeHint: A build from scratch — apply it to an existing character with 'Rebuild with this'.
Plan.DeleteBody: Delete the plan '{name}'? This cannot be undone.
Plan.FreeNote: Applying rebuilds the character with this build. Gear, coins and effects stay.
Plan.ConvertHint: Keeps past levels as on the sheet; only picks for later levels carry over.
Plan.RebuildBody: {actor} will be rebuilt with this build up to level {level}.
Plan.RebuildLoseList: {abc} · {feats} feats · {spells} spells · attribute boosts · skill ranks
Plan.RebuildKeep: Gear, coins, effects, conditions and HP stay. Irreversible — duplicate first.
Plan.RebuildDone: {name} — rebuilt with the new build ({n} changes). This plan now follows the sheet.
Plan.ConvertAsk: Continue '{name}' from the current sheet? Only picks for later levels are kept.

Top.PreviewHint: Preview attributes, skills and statistics at this level

List.PickHint: Click to read it here; double-click or 'Choose' to pick.
List.LegendHint: ?: a prerequisite the builder can't judge. Check it yourself.
List.LegacyDisabled: The GM has hidden legacy content for the whole world in the settings.
List.BoostHint: Only ones boosting every picked attribute. Free boosts don't count.

Pick.HeritageHint: This ancestry's heritages first, then versatile heritages (any ancestry).
Pick.ArchetypeHint: Dedication first. Another Dedication only after two more of its feats.
Pick.DeityHint: Optional unless the class needs one. Click again to deselect.

Locked.Sheet: Up to level {level} this plan follows the sheet; it plans from the next level onward.
Locked.FreeHint: To try a different ancestry, background or class, add an 'A different build from scratch' plan with + above.
Locked.UnlockHint: Allow changing the feats, attribute boosts and skill increases of levels already on the sheet.
Locked.RelockHint: Lock again (your changes stay in the plan).
Locked.UnlockBody: Levels up to Lv {level} become editable. Applying deletes the feats you replace.

Attr.Title: Attribute boosts
Attr.Hint: Pick the level-1 boosts. Levels 5, 10, 15 and 20 give 4 more each.
Attr.AltToggle: Alternate ancestry boosts: 2 free boosts instead of the fixed boosts and flaw
Attr.HintGradual: Pick the level-1 boosts. Gradual boosts are picked on each level's page.
Attr.Key2Hint: Second class's key boost and class DC. Dropped if already +4.

Skills.Title: Skills (level 1)
Skills.Hint: Class and background skills are automatic. Pick {n} more ({left} left).
Skills.Auto: Trained by your class or background

Level.IncreaseHint: At this level a skill can be raised up to {rank} (master from level 7, legendary from level 15).
Level.BoostHint: Four different attributes. At +4 or higher a boost is partial (½); the second partial boost gives +1.
Level.Nothing: Nothing to choose at this level.
Level.RaiseApply: Raise to level {level} and apply the plan
Level.DetailHint: Click a feat or feature to read it here.
Level.BoostTakenAt: Already boosted at level {level} (same group of four levels)
Level.BoostGradualHint: One per level from {from} to {to}, a different attribute each time.

Overview.UploadHint: Upload a picture (large images are shrunk automatically)
Overview.TokenHint: Token image (the portrait is used if none)
Overview.Ring: Use a token ring (portrait inside the ring)
Overview.AllSet: Everything up to level {level} is chosen.
Overview.CreateHint: Creates a level {level} character. The rest of the plan waits for level-up.
Overview.CreateNeed: Choose ancestry, heritage, background, class, key attribute, the 4 level-1 boosts and level-1 skills first.
Overview.ApplyCurrent: Apply what's missing up to level {level}
Overview.StatsNeed: Choose an ancestry and a class to see numbers.

Detail.ChoiceAsk: PF2e will ask {n} more choice(s) when applying to the sheet.
Detail.ToChatHint: Post this to chat as a card so the GM can see what you picked.

Stat.Note: Calculated by PF2e; gear and some choices may be missing.

Compare.Title: Compare — {name}
Compare.Note: Green: better than the first column; red: worse. Previews are approximations (no equipment or later choices).

Create.Confirm: Create {name} as a level {level} character? PF2e may ask a few things.
Create.NoGM: A GM must be online to create a character (the GM's client creates it).
Create.Timeout: No response from the GM. Try again in a moment.
Create.NoUpload: You may not upload files. Ask the GM for the 'Upload New Files' permission.

Apply.Title: Apply the plan up to level {level}
Apply.Body: The following will be added to the sheet (nothing already there is replaced):
Apply.Prompts: PF2e asks for any choice the plan left open.
Apply.Nothing: Nothing to apply — the sheet already follows the plan.

Card.Title: {name} — level {level}!
Card.Body: What builder plan '{plan}' has set up to this level:

Welcome.Title: Character Builder
Welcome.Body: No character yet. Build one? 'Create Character' in the Actors tab also opens it.

Translation.Title: Korean translation
Translation.Body: The builder is tuned to the Rutz Korean translation module; use it alongside.
Translation.Hint: This notice is shown only once. The builder also works with other translations.

Settings.PerPlayerHint: 0 = no limit. Already-assigned characters count; GMs excepted.
Settings.Ownership: Other players' access to new characters
Settings.OwnershipHint: 'Follow the world' copies most PCs' default access. The creator is always owner.
Settings.AllowLevelUp: Players may raise their level in the builder
Settings.AllowLevelUpHint: When off, only the GM raises levels; players just apply their plan to the level they've reached.
Settings.LevelUpCardHint: When a character gains a level, its owner gets a whispered card with an 'Apply the plan' button.
Settings.PromptNew: Offer the builder to players without a character
Settings.PromptNewHint: On login, players without a character are asked whether to open the builder.
Settings.FolderHint: Actor folder name (blank: no folder). Created if missing.
Settings.PacksHint: Comma-separated pack IDs. Blank: chosen automatically.
Settings.TrModuleHint: Blank: looks for a Korean translation module with 'rutz' in its ID, title or authors.
Settings.TrUrlHint: Manifest or page URL shown in the notice (optional).
Settings.HideLegacyHint: Hides legacy entries in every user's builder. Existing plans are kept.
Settings.PacksMenuHint: Choose the packs to read ancestries, classes and feats from, plus world homebrew.
Settings.TidyChoicesHint: Drops unused packs and duplicates from PF2e's 'choose one' windows.
Settings.LevelCantripsHint: Spellbook and familiar classes may count a cantrip as a level-up spell.
Settings.AutoClassSpellsHint: Also adds spells from feats and class features gained on the sheet.
Settings.AllowRebuild: Players may rebuild their character in the builder
Settings.AllowRebuildHint: When off, only the GM can rebuild a character from a from-scratch build.
Settings.SlotClassBonus: Table rule: extra class spell slots
Settings.SlotClassBonusHint: Extra slots for every rank that has slots. 0 = as written.
Settings.SlotArchetypeHint: Slots per opened rank in the archetype's spell entry. As written: 1.
Settings.SlotStrays: Warn about archetype spells in the class entry
Settings.SlotStraysHint: Warns when the class entry holds spells from an archetype's list.

Ask.Title: Choices
Ask.Body: {name} has choices. Answer now and PF2e won't ask again when applying.

Pending.Title: Not chosen yet
Pending.Asks: Choices PF2e will ask while applying: {n}
Pending.Hint: If you continue, empty slots are left empty (you can fill them on the sheet later).

Spells.Title: Spell plan
Spells.Hint: Pick the casting style and spells per level; entries are set up automatically.
Spells.NoCastingHint: Pick a tradition if your class casts spells.
Spells.SubclassHint: This class's tradition depends on a subclass (bloodline, patron …) — pick it yourself.
Spells.AtLevel: Spells to learn at this level (up to rank {rank})
Spells.PickHint: Double-click or 'Choose' to add or remove. Faded: picked at another level.
Spells.ListHint: Prepares from the whole list daily; nothing to learn, but you can note favorites.
Spells.NoClassSpells: No granted spells yet; picking a patron, bloodline or muse adds them.
Spells.ClassGives: Spells your class grants up to level {level} (depends on planned feats)
Spells.Mode_book: Spellbook: set number at level 1, 2 more each level; prepare up to your slots.
Spells.Mode_rep: Repertoire: learn one spell of a rank each time you gain a slot of that rank (slots = spells known).
Spells.Mode_list: Whole list: prepare up to your slots daily from your tradition's list.

Learn.WizardNote: Plus 2 1st-rank curriculum spells, and 1 curriculum spell for each new rank.
Learn.WitchNote: Plus 1 patron spell (known by your familiar), granted by your patron.
Learn.NecroNote: Harm is added to your spellbook separately.
Learn.ClericNote: Divine font gives extra heal/harm slots (4 at level 1, 5 at level 5, 6 at level 15).
Learn.SorcNote: The first spell of each rank (and one cantrip) comes from your bloodline and is not counted here.

Extra.Psychic: Your conscious mind grants 3 extra psi cantrips.
Extra.Animist: Apparition spell slots and apparition cantrips are separate.
Extra.Sorcerer: Bloodline spells are included in these slots.
Extra.Wizard: Plus one curriculum slot per rank.

Spells.ResyncHint: Adds spells from class features and feats; sets daily slots by the class table.
Spells.Strays: “{entry}” has spells off this class's tradition: {list}. Remove unless intended.
Spells.Tick: Check to learn it at this level

DeityAlignment.Hint: Legacy alignment: {alignment} (the deity's own, not its followers' allowed alignments)

Packs.Title: Compendiums the builder reads
Packs.Hint: Only checked packs show in the builder. Changed rows are highlighted.
Packs.Saved: Compendium selection saved. Open builders will reload.
Packs.WorldHint: Homebrew made right in the Items sidebar. {n} now.
Packs.World_visible: Players see only the ones they have permission for (Limited or better)

Choice.PickHint: Click to read it on the right; double-click or 'Choose' to pick.
Choice.AskPeek: Pick one to read its description here.

Setup.Title: Spell setup
Setup.Book: Spellbook: {c} cantrips, {s} spells → prepare {pc} cantrips, {ps} spells a day.
Setup.Rep: Learn {c} cantrips and {s} spells for your repertoire (cast any of them, up to your slots).
Setup.List: Prepare {pc} cantrips and {ps} spells from your whole list each day.
Setup.NoTradition: tradition not set (comes from your subclass)
Setup.FeatHint: Focus spells come from class features, subclass and planned feats.

Fam.Title: Familiar Builder
Fam.CannotCreate: You can't create actors. Ask the GM to make the familiar.
Fam.CountHint: Familiar and master abilities per day, as PF2e calculates.
Fam.NoFamiliar: No familiar actor has this character as master. Create one above.
Fam.PickHint: Click an ability to read it and its prerequisites here. Double-click to add.
Fam.Patron: From the witch's patron; applied automatically with it.
Fam.Specific: Only for a specific familiar ({folder}) — have the GM confirm yours qualifies.

KindHint.master: Abilities you (the master) gain — they count with the familiar abilities.
KindHint.special: Abilities only certain familiars or witch patrons have.

Need.Rank: Can cast rank {n} spells using spell slots
Need.Cantrips: Can prepare cantrips or add them to a repertoire

Ask.Shadow: Shadow familiar only (any familiar for a shadowcaster)

Homebrew.NoTable: If it casts: no spell table, so counts aren't tracked. The GM can set one up.
Homebrew.NoTableGm: If it casts: no spell table. Set one once for every character of this class here.
Homebrew.Title: Spellcasting — {name}
Homebrew.FormHint: How {name} casts. Start from a printed class that works the same way, then change what differs.
Homebrew.LikeHint: Fills in the fields below from that class.
Homebrew.Slots_full: 3 per rank (wizard, cleric, druid, bard, witch)
Homebrew.Learn_book: Spellbook — a start at level 1, then some each level
Homebrew.Learn_rep: Repertoire — one spell known per slot
Homebrew.Learn_list: Prepares from the whole list (nothing to learn)
Homebrew.BookHint: Cantrips · 1st-rank spells at level 1 · spells added each level after that (a wizard: 10 · 5 · 2).
Homebrew.WorldNote: Saved in this world as {slug}. To ship it in the class item, see the wiki.

Dual.HintFirst: Dual-class world: pick the first class, then the second in the next tab.
Dual.Hint: Gets both classes' features and feats; HP and proficiencies use the better one.
